name: Access Holdings
source: Access Holdings Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2023: consolidated statement of comprehensive income (page 5) for FY2023 and FY2022, and the five year financial summary (page 215) for FY2021 to FY2019. N millions scaled to units. FY2023 and FY2024 total assets, total liabilities and total equity are the printed summary rows; every ratio is computed from the two printed figures named in its note.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.note: Gross earnings as printed. FY2023 and FY2022 from the consolidated statement of comprehensive income; FY2021 to FY2019 from the audited five year financial summary, page 215.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: Not collected for these years. The two stored columns carry operating expenses; the five year summary does not print the line and the FY2023 statement totals it inside operating income.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: Profit before income tax as printed, consolidated statement of comprehensive income and five year financial summary.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: Income tax expense as printed for FY2023 and FY2022, expense negative to match the two stored columns. FY2021 to FY2019 derived as profit for the period less profit before tax, both printed in the five year financial summary; the two printed lines reproduce exactly.

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.note: Profit for the year as printed. FY2022 is 152,202 after a printed 700 million discontinued operation below the tax line; the continuing figure is 152,902.

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: Basic earnings per share in naira as printed. The FY2022 statement prints 449 kobo; the five year summary on page 215 prints 445 kobo for the same year and is not used.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.note: Net profit over total equity, both printed in the five year financial summary.

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.note: Net profit over total assets, both printed in the five year financial summary.

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.note: Total liabilities over total equity, both printed in the five year financial summary.

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: Not collected for these years. Interest expense on deposits is printed in the value added statement (827,826 for FY2023 and 391,447 for FY2022) but that is not the same line as the two stored columns.
